thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1766660001 - Elevated 5xx rate detected in eu-west (gateway layer). 5m spike above threshold (rate 6.8% -> 23%). Auto-paging oncall.
oncall-jamie: I'm awake, looking now. Paging @sre-maria for help.
sre-maria: I'm on. seeing a spike in gateway 502/504s and increased backend timeouts to redis-proxy-eu. Grafana: latency tail climbing, p95 from 180ms -> 520ms over last 6m.
eng-runtime-liam: adding context — we pushed runtime kernel roll last week to eu-west pool, but metrics looked stable earlier. Could be correlated but unknown.
oncall-jamie: Can someone share quick query counts? how many requests/sec and error-rate per route?
sre-maria: Quick snapshot: total rps ~ 2200 in eu-west, error breakdown: 502 gateway 12.9%, 504 upstream timeout 6.8%, 500 internal 3.3%. Affected mainly /v1/generate and websocket ingress.
eng-platform-sara: Not seeing infra autoscale events. No capacity alarms. Pools show saturated connection queues on edge-proxy pods (queue depth > 500 in some shards).
support-ellie: Got inbound from a couple of customers noting higher latencies and some 502s in the last 10 minutes. Tickets coming in.
cs-zoe: Customer-impact check: 3 enterprise customers reported intermittent failures, one reported failing health checks on internal side. Not yet a widespread outage but growing.
oncall-jamie: OK prioritize mitigation: short-term across-control-plane steps: 1) divert new traffic to eu-central, 2) reduce burst capacity usage in eu-west, 3) drain unhealthy edge-proxies. Thoughts?
sre-maria: Agree. Start cross-region steer: set routing weight eu-west -> 40%, eu-central -> 60% for new sessions. Keep existing sticky sessions for 5m to reduce user rehydration issues.
eng-platform-sara: Preparing routing change. Command to update traffic policy (internal tool):

```
rbctl route update --region eu-west --weight 40 --region eu-central --weight 60 --sticky 300
```

I'll apply now and watch.
eng-runtime-liam: While that's in-flight, check KV cache pressure on the runtime — logs show many KV cache misses and repeated full-key evictions in tokenizer-cache; could be causing backend thrash.
sre-maria: Also seeing redis-proxy connection errors 4xx/5xx: 'ERR maxclients' in logs around 1766660005.
eng-platform-sara: Routing update applied at 1766660058. Initial telemetry: synthesis rps in eu-west dropped ~45% over 90s. Error rate in eu-west decreased from 23% -> 12%.
oncall-jamie: Good. Keep monitoring. Can we scale redis-proxy or recycle the affected pods?
eng-runtime-liam: Scaling redis-proxy horizontally will help, but need to rebalance shards. I'll trigger a graceful restart cycle on edge-proxy pods with highest queue depth first.
eng-runtime-liam: Restarting edge-proxy pods on shard-3 now:

```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy-shard-3 -n prod --grace-period=60
```

Logs: restarting pod edge-proxy-3a -> showing healthy on ready checks at 1766660188.
sre-maria: After restarts, connection queue depth fell to under 120. Redis proxies still showing occasional 'maxclients' errors — increasing maxclients limit might be needed, but let's be cautious.
eng-platform-sara: Confirmed: redis-proxy replicas in eu-west are at autocount=3. K8s HPA not scaling because CPU/Memory thresholds not hit; issue is file/conn limits. I can bump ulimit via a rolling deploy but needs a short window.
support-ellie: Meanwhile, support team put notice on status page: brief note about elevated error rates in EU and that engineering is investigating. Customers asking about expected ETA — what should we say?
cs-zoe: Recommend: "Investigating elevated error rates in EU region; mitigation in progress, cross-region routing active. Minimal user impact for most; follow-up in 30 minutes." keeps expectations conservative.
oncall-jamie: Good. Set status update now.
incident-bot: STATUS_UPDATE posted to status.redwood.ai at 1766660220.
eng-runtime-liam: I propose two midterm ops: (A) bump redis-proxy maxclients + rolling restart; (B) temporary connection-pooling at gateway to limit backend fanout. Which first?
sre-maria: Do (B) first to reduce fanout immediately, then (A) if errors persist. Implement connection-pooling throttle via gateway config change (hot reload).
eng-platform-sara: Pushing gateway config patch now. Patch snippet:

```
- max_backend_conn_per_route: 200
+ max_backend_conn_per_route: 80
```

Hot reload applied at 1766660285. Observing backend fanout drop ~60%.
eng-runtime-liam: Nice — error burst reduced. Eu-west 5xx now ~6.4%. Latency p95 back to ~240ms.
sre-maria: Good stabilization. Recommend keeping cross-region steering for durability until root cause fixed and we validate redis-proxy changes.
eng-platform-sara: I'll schedule a controlled bump of redis-proxy maxclients and ulimit with a short maintenance window in 15 minutes. Rolling restart will be staged to avoid flapping.
oncall-jamie: Proceed. Also let's instrument a specific log marker to trace any residual 502s: add request_id -> redis-proxy logs correlation.
eng-runtime-liam: Added correlation header propagate x-rw-request-id — visible in redis-proxy logs now.
sre-maria: After redis-proxy ulimit bump and restart, maxclients errors cleared. Confirmed at 1766660450. Edge-proxy queues stable.
cs-zoe: Customers updated: one major customer still seeing occasional failures — support created a dedicated bridge with their on-call, sending their request_ids for tracing.
support-ellie: Got their ids, passing to eng-runtime for waterfall trace.
eng-runtime-liam: Trace shows a slow upstream > 3s during a tokenization-heavy request and then a connection timeout; that path was amplified under high cache miss. With reduced fanout and cache steady-state, they should be OK.
oncall-jamie: Monitoring for 15m stabilization window. If stable, we move to recovery play: restore routing weights to normal gradually.
eng-platform-sara: I'll step weights back to eu-west 80% / eu-central 20% in two stages over 10 minutes.
eng-platform-sara: Stage1 at 1766660840 set eu-west -> 60%.
eng-platform-sara: Stage2 at 1766661140 set eu-west -> 80%.
eng-platform-sara: Completed. No reemergence of errors. Final 5xx in eu-west at 0.9%.
incident-bot: INCIDENT_RESOLVED candidate flagged. Recommend postmortem and RCA.
oncall-jamie: Filing incident ticket. Immediate actions: document runbook gaps (conn limit not surfaced in autoscaling metrics, KV cache eviction signal missing), add extra alerting on redis maxclients and queue depth.
sre-maria: RCA hypotheses: root cause was a combination of increased cache misses after a model-serving config change last week + connection limit exhaustion on redis-proxy under high concurrent tokenization requests. Contributing: lack of fanout-throttling by default.
cs-zoe: Customer comms drafted. Will send out a summary and committed mitigations.
night-oncall-ryan: Taking handoff for the night. I'll watch EU metrics and the ticket. Ping me or escalate if error > 3% for 10m.
oncall-jamie: Thanks Ryan. Closing live thread. Follow-up: schedule postmortem meeting and assign owners for alerting + runbook updates.
sre-maria: Adding checklist to incident ticket: /postmortem template link

```
- timeline
- mitigation steps
- root cause
- action items + owners
```

incident-bot: Thread archived at 1766665400.
